name: Arthur Thurston

text.trigger: Arthur searches while his player is still in the colony.
text.vignette: The feral kids have trailed Arthur for blocks, a ragged line of faces with nothing behind the eyes. They close in around the cart he is guarding, and he knows how this ends whichever way he leans.

options.drive-them-off: He fights them off barehanded and bleeds for it: Arthur takes 2 wounds.
options.open-fire: He fires into the crowd and lives with it: morale falls by 1.

notes: src: Crossroad_cards_v1.1.xlsx.txt card #17; survivor card; trigger point action.search is a stand-in for "controls Arthur". Mature flag is our reading (violence against children)
